column2: What's wrong, Al-kun? Are you feeling sick? You look pale...
...I put the power of a charm into the stone I gave you, Gin-san.
Please, never let go of it.
Okay, thanks!
When we get back, I'll treat you to something yummy, so look forward to it!
Past this hole is their hideout.
Well, well. Those Poachers sure dug themselves one huge-ass tunnel...
Stay on guard. I sense strong killing intent ahead.
Like I explained, Ban-kun and the others will retrieve the DVD-ROM,
and Himiko-san and Akabane-san will transport the DVD-ROM once it's back...
...Wait, what's that noise?!
? Huh, is something shaking...?!
Damn, this is bad... Hurry, move it!!
...We've been cut off completely. So the enemy saw our moves coming.
Divide and conquer, huh...
Wait, why the hell are YOU here?!
How should I know? You're the one who tagged along after me.
What'd you say, punk?! You wanna go, huh?
Hey, don't start some ugly squabble in a place like this.
Work comes first, right?
Uptight as ever, aren't you...
Of course! Come on, we're moving on!!
Fwahahahahaha! Alright, you lot! Stop right there!
That spot is gonna be your grave! Muhihihihihihi!!
So they finally show up...
Gufufufufufu... Go straight to Heeeeeeeell!!
Hmph... All talk, these guys.
That wasn't nearly enough for me...
Well, that's enough playing with small fry. Let's hurry on!
Are you alright, Kazuki?
Yes. I'm sorry, Juubei...
Oh no! In this setup, ain't I the only one left out?
Where's my partner, Shido-han?! Shido-haaaaan!!
Quiet, Emishi. We're going to look for him now.
R-right!
(Even so, I gotta meet up with him quick! I hate bein' left out~!)
Fshushushururu...
Well, aren't you some slippery little rabbits!!
An ambush... how cowardly...
If you will not step aside quietly, Kazuki of the Strings shall judge you with death!
...Looks like one damn cheeky rabbit got mixed in with the rest!
Forget the hunt, it's cooking time... I'll make mincemeat of you in no time!!
Man, those guys went down easy, huh~
Kazuki, it seems you were hurt in that fight. Let me see.
It's nothing serious, but... thank you, Juubei.
(Oh no! I really am the only one left out! I'm hurt too, y'know!
...I seriously hate this setup~!!)
...Huh? Ban-chaaan! Everyone~!!
...Nobody's here... Did we get separated? I feel kinda lonely...
Heh... I am glad to see you unhurt, Ginji-kun.
Hweh? A-Akabane-san?! U-um, what happened, exactly?
It seems we fell for the enemy's scheme and were split up.
There was no one else around.
Huh? So it's... just the two of us?
Yes♥
Akabane
This should be a fun job♥
Ha ha... Y-yes, it should...
?! The stone Al-kun gave me is glowing...
This is Dark... right? Ha ha... That kinda suits Akabane-san...
Is something the matter, Ginji-kun?
N-no, nothing at all... Ha ha ha...
...Ginji-kun.
Y-yes! What is it?
Have you not noticed? It seems they have finally decided to show themselves.
Geheh, gehe-gehe-geheh!!
So you noticed we were here... Pretty sharp, ain't ya!!
With killing intent that obvious, anyone would notice.
Is that not right, Ginji-kun?
...O-of course!
(I didn't notice at all...)
Wh-why, you~!
I'll shut those cheeky mouths of yours forever~!!
Looks like he passed out... maybe?
! Dr. Jackal!!
You don't have to finish off someone who's already out cold!!
...How naive, Ginji-kun.
This man is not unconscious at all. Is that not so?
Eeeeeeeek!!
He doesn't want to fight anymore!
If you're that set on fighting, then I'll take you on!!
...Interesting.
(...Ugh, I got carried away and said I'd take him on...
I'm in trouble......)
No, no, I must not...
For now, you are my partner on this job, are you not? Heh heh heh... A pity. Truly.
Now then, shall we hurry on?
(Phew~, thank goodness~...)
Ginji-san!
Kazu-chaaan, Juubei, Emishi!! You're all okay~!!
Yo, Ginji! Looks like you're doing fine!!
B-Ban-chaaan! We both made it out alive! I was so scared~, so lonely~!!
...Jeez, what a drama queen.
Sh-Shido-haaaan! I was so lonely~!
Don't you ever leave me again!!
Shut up... Get off me, Emishi.
...Rejoice in your reunion all you like, but the fighting has only just begun.
Right... Let's find their hideout fast and wrap up this job.
Looks like this here's their hideout.
Hey, hey, those not-human enemies Hevn-san talked about aren't showing up.
What happened to them, I wonder?
...Who knows? Maybe they got scared of us and ran off.
Anyway, the only way is forward!
!! What on earth is that...?!
At times like this, you strike first! Eat this, Snake Bite!!
! The way that felt... Yeah, that thing ain't human.
Indeed. I sense nothing like life coming from that thing.
If they're not human, what are they? Robots or something?!
Beats me... Well, we'll find out once we beat 'em!
We did it! Is it... over?!
What the hell was that thing... Not a robot either... More like a doll?!
I see. A rather interesting bunch...
?! Who's there?!
You are the one who holds the power of thunder, are you not?
...That power is awakening. Dangerous. Best that I dispose of you here.
Wh-what? Ugh!! Hkk... Ngggh......
Ginjiii!!
?! ...What the-- I can't move!!
Damn it! At this rate...
It was blocked?
...So that thing is behind this. Very well. I shall let you go, for now.
Farewell. We shall meet again.
Hah, hah, hah...... What was that just now...?!
Ginji, you okay?
Y-yeah, somehow...
Huh? The stone Al-kun gave me is broken...
...I don't know why, but I've got a bad feeling.
...So, was the DVD-ROM there?
Yes, we found it.
Alright, retrieval complete! Let's head back!!
We're baaack!
...Oh, it's you two.
What's this, what's this? Why's it so gloomy in here?!
Hey, Hevn! Here's the goods. Hurry up and take us to the client.
...About that. I can't get in touch with the client.
You can't get in touch?!
Hevn-san, what do you mean?
I don't really know myself. Contact just suddenly cut off... and that was it.
Whaaat?
Huh, come to think of it, where's Al-kun?
He suddenly disappeared. He left this note behind...
A note...?
'Everyone, thank you for all you did for me until now.
Me, I must go now. Sorry. Goodbye.'
...This is...
Honestly, I haven't got a clue what's going on...
D-don't give me "haven't got a clue"! You call yourself a broker?!
What happens to our 2 million?!
I guess it's... o-n h-o-l-d♥
Gwah... grrr... Don't "o-n h-o-l-d" me~!!
Press SELECT to switch parties.
What's this? Something's written on the wall...
...Lemme see?
ABCDEFGHIJKLMN OPQRSTUVWXYZ...
...That's just the alphabet! What the hell is this?
There's more... Red: RED, Blue: BLUE
Yellow: YELLOW, Green: GREEN, White: WHITE, Silver: SILVER
Purple: PURPLE, Orange: ORANGE...
Note: Before pressing a switch, first examine the door...
...Smells like there's something to this.
What's this? Something's written on the wall...
...Lemme see?
ABCDEFGHIJKLMN OPQRSTUVWXYZ...
...That's just the alphabet! What the hell is this?
There's more... Red: RED, Blue: BLUE
Yellow: YELLOW, Green: GREEN, White: WHITE, Silver: SILVER
Purple: PURPLE, Orange: ORANGE...
Note: Before pressing a switch, first examine the door...
Invalid if the door has not been examined.
There are numbers on the doors. Guess the numbers tie in with that?
...The switches are colored, aren't they?
Well, the one over there's yellow, right?
So that makes it YELLOW... What number letter of the alphabet is Y?
It's number 25.
Isn't that the idea?
